description: Me-google rules registry — machine-readable index of all derived and manual rules.

entries.title: All commits must use Conventional Commits format
entries.directive: Every commit message must begin with a type prefix: feat:, fix:, docs:, refactor:, test:, chore:, ci:, research:, perf:. Do not commit without a type prefix.
entries.rationale: Conventional Commits enable automated changelogs and clear history.

entries.title: Resolve bottleneck tasks before picking up new work
entries.directive: Before starting a new task, check whether any open task blocks ≥2 others. If so, prioritise that blocking task.
entries.rationale: Bottleneck tasks multiply their delay across every dependent task.
entries.evidence: Bottleneck tasks (each blocks ≥2 others): TASK-005, TASK-010, TASK-013.

entries.title: Every source file must have a corresponding test file
entries.directive: When creating any source file in core/ or services/, immediately create test_<filename> in the same directory. A PR adding source without tests must not be merged.
entries.rationale: Untested code leads to silent regressions, especially in shared core logic.
entries.evidence: 7 source file(s) have no corresponding test file.

entries.title: Every module directory must contain a README.md
entries.directive: When scaffolding any new directory in core/, services/, or platform/, add a README.md explaining the module's purpose, its public API, and how to run its tests.
entries.rationale: Undocumented modules prevent new agents from understanding the codebase.

entries.title: Source files must stay under 500 lines
entries.directive: If a source file exceeds 500 lines, split it into focused sub-modules. Use one file per class / concern. Prefer composition over monoliths.
entries.rationale: Large files are harder to understand, review, and test.
entries.evidence: 4 file(s) exceed 500 lines and may need splitting.

entries.title: Scaffold required directories before implementing features
entries.directive: The first PR for any platform or module must create the directory with a README.md. Never add feature code to a directory that hasn't been formally scaffolded.
entries.rationale: Premature feature code without structure leads to tangled modules.
entries.evidence: 5 required directories do not exist yet.
